b:
It was the corner classroom
of that
tuition centre

From the burning sun
the lime tree
and that small roof
gave shade

I sat there with my preparations
for the next hour

For the dictation test
my brain would chew over
the words

Both adrenal glands
would start
their work

Those were days
when I looked for omens
and prayed for luck

There were also days
when all precautions
lost their strength

On those days
the tears would come
before the ears had heard

And the handkerchiefs
were ready for them

Now that the years have rolled by
the wounds taste sweet
I shed tears,
not from the wound,
but from longing
for what I can no longer see
